name: Szentjakabfa (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated stripe of red and blue triangles along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szentjakabfa: a blue and red shield with a cross, a bunch of grapes and a scallop shell, between oak boughs, above a scroll inscribed SZENTJAKABFA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szentjakabfa arms with boughs and scroll
